blind.description: A low, solid stone or masonry dais consisting of an elevated rectangular platform with lower step sections running along the sides. The upper platform is paved with rectangular flagstones featuring a dark grey border and a central geometric pattern composed of tan and grey square tiles. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly beveled with no floating pieces, holes, or melting. The underside rests flat on the ground. Colors include earthy tans, warm browns, and weathered slate greys.
blind.from_above: A rectangular block with a lighter tan and slate-grey patterned tile surface surrounded by a dark border, framed partially on three outer sides by lower step ledges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1 to 1.5 ft tall (about 1/4 to 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 4.5 ft wide and 7 ft long.

notes: Height is slightly taller than catalog target (0.19 length vs 0.09), but clearly reads as a low stepped stone platform at table distance
